messages:
anya: Heads-up — CS just escalated a P1 for customer LumenArc: spike in 504s from the dedicated pool in us-east-1 since ~03:40 UTC. They want an ETA for a mitigation. Who can own immediate routing/workaround?
ben: I can take routing fallback ownership. Quick Q: is the error surface only for LumenArc or other tenants on the same pool?
cleo: quick check — logs show KV cache miss storm and high tail latencies on pool-7. The batching patch we rolled yesterday touched the cache warmup path.
mike: if batching patch is the culprit, we have two short-term options: rollback the patch on pool-7 (longer, needs infra review) or route LumenArc traffic away from pool-7 to pool-5 as an emergency fallback. Routing change = fastest.
sara: I can apply the routing change now if we have the exact command and target weights. Ben — want 100% -> pool-5 or split?
ben: 100% to pool-5 for now. Command we use on the service router:```sh
# set LumenArc routing to pool-5
kubectl patch configmap lumenarc-routing -n infra --type merge -p '{"data":{"preferred_pool":"pool-5"}}'
```
cleo: confirm deploy-bot shows the batching change was rolled out to pool-7 at 2026-03-17T02:12Z by cleo. If we route, we should also roll back the batching patch in parallel once infra sign-off is quick.
deploy-bot: Deployment detected: service=batching-agent, env=prod-us-east, target=pool-7, user=cleo, ts=2026-03-17T02:12:05Z
incident-bot: Incident created: #INC-2026-1047 "LumenArc dedicated pool 504s" — paging eng-platform, eng-infra, oncall.
jamie: tagging eng-infra now for rollback approval: @mike @ben — can infra approve an emergency rollback without the usual 4-hour window?
mike: we can fast-track a rollback if we provide rollback plan & smoke tests. I can coordinate but need someone to do the traffic shift first.
sara: applying routing change to move LumenArc to pool-5 now (will post status).
(sara posts) sara: applied patch; routing change requested. Running canary traffic sanity checks.
cleo: I'm watching metrics. Within 3m of reroute I see 504 rate drop by ~80% for LumenArc. Other tenants on pool-5 show normal behavior.
ben: good. Ben -> I'll confirm with CS that service is restored and ask them to validate. Ben to own customer communication.
cleo: starting rollback of batching patch on pool-7 now (will run smoke). Command: ```sh
# rollback to previous image
kubectl set image deployment/batching-agent batching-agent=registry.redwood/batching-agent:2026-03-16-rc1 -n prod-us-east
```
mike: infra run smoke tests on pool-7 after rollback. If green, we'll leave routing in place for 30m then gradually shift back.
cleo: rollback applied at 03:55 UTC. Smoke tests passing. 504s trending down overall.
ben: CS confirmed LumenArc is seeing normal traffic now. Marking immediate mitigation successful.
anya: thanks everyone. Next steps: 1) Ben + CS to confirm full customer validation (by +30m). 2) Cleo + Mike to run a short postmortem checklist and identify root cause and release gating to prevent cache-warmup regressions. 3) Sara to record the exact routing command in runbook.
jamie: created tracker task PM-2349 for postmortem and linked to incident #INC-2026-1047 — https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/PM-2349 :white_check_mark:
anya: great. I'll update exec and close the incident when CS confirms. If anything regresses here, re-open thread with "REGRESS" prefix. :thumbsup:
